question: How should the practitioner visualize the self in relation to the dark four-armed goddess?
premises: The goddess is visualized as dark, three-eyed, and four-armed.
The practitioner meditates on the self as well.
The visualization identifies the self with that form.
inference: One should meditate on oneself as the dark, three-eyed, four-armed goddess.
